name: Environment Declaration
description: Declares one implementation environment without embedding hosting-provider ownership or credentials.
purpose: Allows code, APIs, integrations and content delivery to be environment-aware while keeping the contract hosting-neutral.

fields.description: Stable environment key unique inside the Site Manifest.

options.label: Development
options.description: Local or developer-controlled non-public execution environment.

options.label: Preview
options.description: Ephemeral or controlled review environment for unpublished work.

options.label: Staging
options.description: Persistent non-production environment used for acceptance/integration testing.

fields.description: Optional externally reachable URL for this environment.
Whether this environment declaration is active.

validationRules.description: Environment IDs must be unique within a Site Manifest.
A Site Manifest may declare at most one enabled production environment.
Externally reachable preview, staging and production baseUrl values must use HTTPS.
Environment declarations must not contain hosting subscription, billing, provider credentials or server-control data.

delivery.notes: Manifest definitions contain technical declarations only. Secret values are prohibited.
